text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I pop by the library and
happen to find
Wonder Acute writing a
letter of some sort.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's customary to finish with a warm and
respectful
salutation. There, that should
do it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm responding to a fan letter. This one
came in
from abroad, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It seems this person happened to see a
race of
mine during a trip to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing your tenacity in the face of
incredible
odds gave me so much
courage..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm working hard every day so that I can
come
back to Japan and watch you race
again
someday."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It sure was a surprise that I was able to
inspire
someone all the way across the
ocean with my
running.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It feels like just yesterday that all I
could do was
stand ringside and cheer on the
boxers from my
father's gym.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But now, after coming to Tracen
Academy and
receiving your expert
guidance...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've been able to encourage someone
I've never
met, simply by racing with all I
have.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But what absolutely tickles me pink is
hearing
that this person has made it a
goal to come and
see me again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The reason I race is to inspire people
who are working hard, but I never
imagined those
intentions would reach
someone this way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my. You might be right about that.
choice_data_list: We'll have to run farther and run ...
We'll have to run farther and run ...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What a waste it would be if my new fan
came all
the way back to Japan only to
see me running
without any zip!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As they say, a journey of a thousand
miles begins
with a single step.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We both need to move forward little by
little
until the time comes when we can
enjoy a happy
reunion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There you have it! Let's make the most
of today
and keep up the steady
progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Wonder Acute
becomes even
more passionate about
our training sessions.
